Environment concept art for a science fiction exploration game: a wide establishing view from a low balcony over a warren of narrow winding market lanes between the feet of giant coral and teal towers at dusk; the lanes are walled with stacked second-hand screens and monitors of every size, up to the first floors, each glowing its own saturated colour, showing faces, planets and glyphs; striped awnings, hanging cables, steam from food stalls, menders at work under lamps, little courts where lanes meet; one image of a face is passed from screen to screen along a lane like a moving light; far away down a gap between the towers, a tall dark tower with covered screens. A small cloaked human traveller with a round jade glass fluid backpack walks into the nearest lane for scale.
